newsitem.title: USA: Getty sees charge causing Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Getty sees charge causing Q4 loss.

text.p: Getty Petroleum Corp said it will record a pretax charge of $21.2 million for environmental expenditures, which will result in a loss for its fiscal fourth quarter ended January 31.
The company said the charge represents estimated environmental costs to be incurred over the next several years for remediation at retail sites.
In addition, Getty estimated it will spend about $20 million for capital expenditures to meet December 1998 compliance deadline.
The company warned that the expenditure could be substantially antially higher though due to uncertainties associated with environmental expenditures.
Any additional amounts will be reflected in Getty's financial statements as they become known, it said.
